title: Blu Froggys
description: Biology be damned, this texture pack makes Warm into Temperate, Temperate into Cold, and Cold into Blue
body: Biology be damned, this texture pack makes Warm into Temperate, Temperate into Cold, and Cold into Blue. The colors are based off vibes purely, even if the colors aren't accurate to the real world. Plus, I just wanted the 'default' frog to be green, and I wanted a blue frog
